reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness Web settings plugin that visualizes client plugin and slot relationships as an interactive force-directed graph.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置页中，以可交互的力导向图展示客户端插件与插槽之间的关系。
summaries.en: An interactive force-directed graph for viewing relationships between DeepSeek Harness client plugins and slots in the Web settings page.

capabilities: Reads client plugin and slot registry snapshots
Renders an interactive force-directed relationship graph
Supports local graph navigation, zooming, dragging, highlighting, and manual refresh
